summary: The customer called angrily because their newly purchased internet router was not working after two days. The agent apologized, verified the account number, guided the customer to power-cycle the device while the agent re-sent the signal from the system, and successfully resolved the issue. The call ended cordially with the customer satisfied with the internet speed.

evidence.text: أبداً ولا يهمك، حقك علي ويسعدني إني قدرت أساعدك.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained a calm, polite, and professional demeanor throughout the call, even when the customer was frustrated.

evidence.text: بعتذر منك كتير على الإزعاج، وبقدر تفهم عصبيتك.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent immediately acknowledged the customer's frustration and offered a sincere apology and validation.

evidence.text: أوه! ضوء الإنترنت صار أزرق وثابت، مش أحمر!
evidence.speaker: Customer

rubric_scores.justification: The agent successfully diagnosed the issue and guided the customer to fix the router connection completely.

evidence.text: هسا أنا رح أعمل إعادة إرسال للإشارة من عندي، ممكن تطفي الراوتر وتشيله من الكهرباء؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: Instructions provided by the agent were clear, step-by-step, and easy for the customer to follow.
The agent handled the closure professionally, asked if there was further help needed, and bid a pleasant goodbye.

evidence.text: صحيح، الضوء الأحمر معناه إنه الإشارة لسه ما تفعيلت على الخط الجديد.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent accurately identified the meaning of the red blinking light and performed the correct technical fix.

evidence.text: ممكن تعطني رقم الحساب أو رقم الهوية لو سمحتي؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent followed proper security procedure by requesting the account number before accessing the account.

quote.text: هيهو رقم الحساب 883920. وبسرعة الله يرضى عليكِ عشان عندي شغل ومش فاضي.
